data.name: My Mom Says I’m Fine
data.detailed_description:
STEAM PLAYTEST NOW OPEN

My Mom Says I’m Fine is currently in active development, and the Steam Playtest is now open.

If you play the Playtest, I’d love to hear what you think. Your feedback directly helps improve the game before release — especially gameplay, balance, difficulty, performance, bugs, characters, weapons, and abilities.

Every response helps shape the game.
Would love to hear you're opinion on the game!

ABOUT THE GAME

My Mom Says I’m Fine is a fast-paced action roguelike / bullet heaven set inside a twisted toy room where imagination has gone a little too far.

Choose from different living toys, each with their own weapons, abilities, stats, and playstyle. Fight through increasingly chaotic waves of enemies, collect upgrades, create powerful builds, and grow stronger throughout each run.

Experiment with different characters, unlock new weapons, discover spells and upgrades, improve your runes, and find combinations that completely change how you play.

Every run gives you new choices — and new ways to survive the toy room.

KEY FEATURES

• Fast-paced bullet heaven combat
Fight large waves of enemies while combining attacks, abilities, and upgrades.

• Multiple playable characters
Choose between unique living toys with different stats, weapons, abilities, and playstyles.

• Build your character during every run
Collect spells and upgrades and create powerful combinations as the difficulty increases.

• Weapons, spells, and abilities
Unlock and experiment with different ways to destroy everything around you.

• Permanent progression
Earn rewards, unlock new content, and upgrade runes between runs.

• Different ways to play
Switch between third-person and top-down camera perspectives.

• A dark and surreal toy-room world
Fight creepy enemies inside a strange world built from a child's imagination.

• Single-player PvE action roguelike
Survive, improve your build, complete challenges, and push yourself further with every run.

Survive the toy room. Defeat the things that should have stayed imaginary.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.
